docs.summary: Non-manifold boundary representation of a 3D mesh with arbitrary attributes. Similar to Blender's BMesh, this structure makes procedural mesh creation and arbitrary edits easy while remaining efficient. Supports vertices, edges, loops (face corners), and faces with arbitrary polygon counts and custom attributes on all topological elements.
Distance under which modelling treats points as the same, or as lying on a plane or an edge.
Edge and face flag: a hidden edge joins its faces into one, a hidden face is not drawn.
Edge flag: shading is smooth across the edge.
Face index into whatever list of materials the mesh is shown with.
Face texture mapping, eight floats: U, Uo, V, Vo.
Goes up whenever elements are added or removed, or [`MarkChanged`](#api~Prowl.Vector.Geometry.GeometryData~MarkChanged) is called, so views know to rebuild.
Records a change that adding and removing elements does not, such as moving vertices.
Removes every element, keeping the attribute definitions.
